releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.177: Added optional 3×3 Pattern Lock to the existing Me → Set Diary Lock screen. Pattern is drawn and confirmed twice; the existing PIN fallback, Forgot PIN recovery and optional fingerprint unlock remain available. Existing Note Lock, saved notes, photos, documents, reminders, package identity and signing identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
